data_description.live_window_after_hours: Duration of fast polling mode after kickoff (1 to 6 h).
data_description.phase_change_days: Days after the team's last match, with nothing scheduled after it (or a team not found), before FFBB Tracker suggests following it to its next phase (1 to 30 days).

init.title: “{team_name}”: what do you want to do?
init.description: “{team_name}” can't be found on the FFBB API. Follow it under its new IDs, or ignore this alert.

confirm.title: Find "{team_name}" again
confirm.description: The team "{team_name}" has been unavailable on the FFBB API for several days. This typically happens at the start of a season, when the FFBB assigns new engagement and pool IDs. The next steps search for "{team_name}" again so it can be tracked under its new IDs. Its existing entities are kept, with their IDs, names and history, so your automations and dashboards keep working.

token_refresh_failing.title: FFBB Tracker: Public token refresh failing
token_refresh_failing.description: Updates for "{team_name}" are still working thanks to a fallback token, but the automatic refresh of the FFBB public API token has failed several times in a row. This may mean the FFBB has changed its `competitions.ffbb.com` API and this integration will need an update. Consider checking for a newer release, or opening an issue on GitHub if this persists.
